text.tspan: The driving system shall produce one plan
for each 100 ms step of simulation time.
The driving system shall make each plan by
inference of the pinned AutoE2E checkpoint
on the camera images, the ego-motion
history and the route of its step.
The driving system shall give the
checkpoint, for each step, the images of
six cameras in the order front, front
left, front right, rear left, rear and
rear right, each resized to 512 by 512
pixels, with the front image also at 1024
The driving system shall give the
checkpoint, for each step and each camera,
the seven earlier images captured 0.5 s to
3.5 s before the step at 0.5 s intervals.
The driving system shall give the
checkpoint, for each image, a projection
operator built from the calibration of its
camera, scaled to the size of the image
and expressed in the vehicle frame of the
The driving system shall give the
checkpoint, for each step, the map of the
roads around the vehicle as the
map_context raster of 14 channels in the
by 300 pixels at 0.4 m per pixel, brought
to the time of the step.
The driving system shall give the
checkpoint, for each step, the route from
navigation as the route_mask raster of two
The driving system shall give the
checkpoint, for each step, the last 64
motion samples of the vehicle it commands,
100 ms apart and ending at the step, each
with its speed in m/s and longitudinal
acceleration in m/s², and with yaw rate
and curvature given as 0 rad/s and 0 1/m.
The driving system shall hold the vehicle
at standstill until its camera history and
The driving system shall build its camera
history and its ego-motion history only
from images and samples captured in the
run, with no capture record twice in one
The driving system shall compute each
from its newest valid plan and the current
The driving system shall keep each
the steering and acceleration limits of
the vehicle that its configuration names.
The driving system shall produce each plan
within 100 ms of wall-clock time after the
newest camera image of its step is
The driving system shall carry its plans
and the commands computed from them from
planning to the actuation of the vehicle
The driving system shall publish each plan
for observation, with its producer and its
production time, within 100 ms of wall-
The driving system shall publish for
observation the motion sample of each
step, with its producer and its sample
time, within 100 ms of wall-clock time
The driving system shall publish its
health at least every 200 ms of wall-clock
time, also while it produces no plan.
Whether AAOS SDV receives the publications
of the driving system on time, late or not
at all, the driving system shall produce
plans and commands that differ by no more
than the plans and commands of two runs on
the same inputs with AAOS SDV receiving on
not in the fast control loop)
Whether AAOS SDV receives the publications

within 10 ms of wall-clock time of its
value with AAOS SDV receiving on time.
While in the stop response, the driving
system shall command a deceleration of 4
m/s² until the vehicle is at standstill.
While in the stop response, the driving
system shall hold the steering command at
the last value computed from a valid plan.
After the stop response has brought the
vehicle to standstill, the driving system
shall hold the vehicle at standstill until
When the images of any camera for a step
are missing, invalid or captured more than
200 ms of simulation time before the step,
the driving system shall begin the stop
response within 100 ms of simulation time.
When the newest motion sample is invalid
or more than 200 ms of simulation time
old, the driving system shall begin the
stop response within 100 ms of simulation
When the route is more than 1 s of
simulation time old or holds no route

When the newest valid plan is more than

When a plan arrives that does not hold 64

When no valid command has reached the

apply the stop response at the actuation.
